claims.statement: For C(G;p)=V_{q(G;p)} K_occ(G;p), A_{Gamma,lambda}=D_Gamma-lambda C, and physical restriction j of bias s, the exact identity A(G)=(1-s)A(G0)+sA(G1)+L_Gamma-lambda Xi_j holds, where Xi_j=C(G)-[(1-s)C(G0)+sC(G1)]. Therefore any finite symmetric nonnegative Gamma and selector policy satisfying L_Gamma>=lambda Xi_j at every nonconstant state implies the ordinary all-gate inequality and hence FEI.
claims.scope: All finite Boolean gates at product bias, with constant children assigned C=0; lambda>=0.
